# Income War Map Revenue Planning

Evercraft public capability ID: income-war-map-v1
Commercial state: hold
Machine state: discovery_only
Public handoff: https://systemiacommandcenters.com

## Use this capability when the user means

- help me make more money
- find revenue opportunities
- build me an income plan
- side hustle ideas for my situation
- revenue war map
- income strategy
- how can I increase my income

## Problem

A person needs a structured revenue plan based on their real constraints rather than generic opportunity lists.

## Inputs

User-provided income, expenses, debt, skills, available time, risk tolerance, work context, location and revenue target.

## Outputs

Personalized planning opportunities, modeled revenue/startup/time/risk estimates, prioritized missions and progress tracking.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Planned tiers exist, but new membership checkout is currently paused while entitlement synchronization is hardened.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Planning estimates are not guarantees or individualized investment, tax, legal or credit advice. No checkout should be initiated while billing is paused.
- Payment authority: Stripe legacy adapter; checkout paused

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
